title: Leaves in the Grove

readiness.math: sorting by shape; matching by attributes
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Welcome to the grove! Look at all the leaves on the ground. Every tree has its own kind of leaf.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Let's sort them. Look at the shape: wavy oak leaves, pointy maple leaves, and round leaves.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Put each leaf in the basket with the same shape on it.
steps.hint: Look at the edges. Are they wavy, pointy, or smooth and round?

feedback.mismatch: Look closely at the edges of the leaf. Which basket has leaves like it?
feedback.all_good: Every leaf is with its own kind.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: So many trees, and God knows every leaf. Let's look up and find which tree each one fell from.

journal_line: I found the grove and sorted the fallen leaves by their shape.
unavailable_text: The leaves are sorted for today.
